subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should maintainers approve the `openai/codex-action` 1.8-to-1.11 contract change in workflows that pass OpenAI credentials, or should it be separated until its source/runtime behavior is independently audited?
rationale: This is a supply-chain and credential-boundary decision: the repository policy requires direct Codex dependency inspection, and an automated dependency bump cannot establish whether the new action preserves the repository’s secret-handling and runtime contract.

options.title: Audit and approve the full update
options.body: Review the exact action revisions and merge only after a redacted final-head workflow run confirms the affected credential-bearing paths.

options.title: Split the Codex action upgrade
options.body: Land the non-Codex action pins separately and keep the Codex action revision in a focused PR with explicit contract and credential-boundary review.

options.title: Hold this dependency group
options.body: Pause the grouped update until an owner can review all changed external action contracts together.

recommendation.title: Audit and approve the full update
recommendation.body: Review the exact action revisions and merge only after a redacted final-head workflow run confirms the affected credential-bearing paths.

likelyOwner.reason: Best available low-confidence routing candidate for a repository-wide workflow and external-action boundary decision.
